Commentary.Commentary: The target now is a huge one. Windies will have to do something special to chase this down. New Zealand, on the other hand, should defend this. The wicket is a belter but one just feels the target is a little too big. Do join us for the chase in a bit.

Not a lot you can write about a team’s bowling performance which has been hit for more than 230 runs. They though were decent for the first half of the game but after that, it all went wrong. Their bowlers bowled too many loose deliveries, too many extras and were punished. Surely not what Pollard was expecting after electing to bowl.

End of some brutal hitting! What a performance. What an innings from Glenn Phillips. Take a bow. This innings has to be about him. Yes, Conway too played his part but he surely is the star. The two joined association when New Zealand were in the slightest of trouble but they have taken the Kiwis to a massive total. The two added a 150-plus run stand with the right-hander scoring a ton and the left-hander a half century. The duo have probably batted the Windies out of the game.
On a good length outside off, Conway punches this to covers for a single. New Zealand end with 238/3 at the end of the 20 overs.
Ross Taylor is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! It is the end of a fantastic innings by Phillips! He has been a treat to watch and has done really well to put the Kiwis in a commanding position! Back of a length ball on off, Phillips looks to go big over the off side but he balloons his shot towards covers where the sub, Hayden Walsh gets under this and takes an easy catch. Take a bow, Phillips! Brilliant innings from him!
Glenn Phillips is down and he is in some pain. Might have twisted his knee cap again. The physio is out and is having a look at him. Let's hope he is okay to continue.
On middle, Phillips pushes this towards mid on.
Length delivery on middle, Glenn pushes this to the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! Hitting them for fun now, is Phillips! Good length ball on middle, Phillips heaves this one towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
WIDE! Way outside the off stump. Wided by the umpire.
On middle, knocked towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Kieron Pollard to bowl the final over of the innings.
SIX! Wonderful! Good length ball on off, Conway lofts this one over the long on region for a maximum.
100 FOR PHILLIPS! He roars after punching this! What a beautiful innings this has been! Back of a length on off, Phillips punches this to deep covers for a single.
On off, Conway punches this to point for a single.
FOUR! Tremendous shot! Conway is turning it on at the end of the first innings! Back of a length ball on off, Conway dances down the track and lofts this towards deep covers for a boundary.
Good length on off, Conway looks to have a poke at this but misses.
A yorker on off, Glenn pushes this towards mid on and collects a single. Moves onto 99 now.
Outside off, punched to the deep point region for a brace. Good fielding in the deep. Paul's horrow show with the ball comes to an end.
FOUR! FIFTY FOR CONWAY! His first in International T20I cricket and he has acheived this in some style! A good length ball outside off, Conway smacks this over backward point to find the fence.
SIX! BEAUTY! Conway is joining into the act now! A full toss on middle, Conway clips this one over deep square leg for a biggie.
Just a dot in the Free Hit! A full toss outside off, Conway looks to bang this one but misses it completely.
NO BALL! On a good length around leg, Conway shuffles and looks to paddle this but misses. Paul oversteps and a No Ball is called. A Free Hit wil follow.

SIX! Just a flick of the wrists and he has already collected 10 runs off the first two balls! On a length on middle, Conway flicks this one over the deep mid-wicket region to send it into the stands. NZ well on the way to a good total past 200.
FOUR! Just not Paul's day today! He is being sent all over the park! What a great shot! On a good length on off, Conway lofts this one over the cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Phillips moves to 98! Short ball on middle, Phillips pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Full on middle, Phillips lofts it over long on for a biggie.
WIDE! Cottrell bowls it outside the tramline, Phillips leaves it alone.
Length delivery on middle, Conway looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.

OUT? No, this will be No Ball and the decision will be overturned! A full toss on off, Phillips looks to bang this over the off side and heaves this towards long off. Pollard is there, ready looking for the catch and he takes it cleanly. Glenn asks if this was above the waist and the umpires decide to bring the third umpire into play. The replays are in and the ball is above the waist clearly. The decision is overturned and a No Ball has been called. A Free Hit will follow.
The third umpire is called into play to check if this was above or below the waist. The replay comes in and this was above the waist. This will be not out.
FOUR! Good length delivery on middle, Phillips looks to smash but gets an inside edge. It goes past the leg stump towards fine leg for a boundary.
NO BALL! The ball slips out of Cottrell's hands and goes towards Hetmyer at short third man. The umpire calls this as a No Ball and a Free Hit will follow.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball on off, Phillips guides it past short third man for a boundary.
WIDE! Cottrell bowls it wide outside off, Phillips lets it go.
Full delivery on off, Conway drives it towards covers for a run.
Full on middle, Conway pushes it towards mid on for a single. Hetmyer does really well to dive and stop this one. Saved a couple of runs for his side.
Length delivery on off, Phillips punches it through covers for a run.
PLAY AND A MISS! Full and outside off, Phillips looks to play reverse sweep but misses it. A couple of dots for Glenn in this over as he looks to innovate and play the reverse sweep.
Full on middle, Phillips drives it through mid on. The batsmen get two runs.
PLAY AND A MISS! Back of a length outside off, Phillips looks to play a reverse sweep but misses it.
FOUR! That is smashed! Length delivery on off, Phillips drives it through point for a boundary.
Bowling Change!
Full on off, Phillips hits it over mid off for a run.
PLAY AND A MISS! Full and outside off, Phillips looks to drive but misses it.
Length ball on middle, Conway looks to pull but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off, Phillips punches it through mid off for a single.
SIX! That is clobbered! Full on middle, Phillips lofts it over long on for a biggie. 100 run partnership up for these two. Just the partnership that the Black Caps needed.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, Phillips looks to drive but misses it.
SIX! Amazing shot! Short and outside off, Conway smashes it over point for a maximum.
Full toss on middle, Phillips flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Phillips is on fire! Length delivery on off, Phillips drives it through covers for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Phillips drives it to covers.
1545 local (0245 GMT) - The West Indies players are walking out to the middle. The men for the Kiwis, Glenn Phillips and Devon Conway stride out after them. Oshane Thomas will complete his over.

1530 local (0230 GMT) - The umpires come out to have a chat with the groundstaff. It seems that the rain has stopped for now. The umpires have decided to have the restart at 1545 local (0245 GMT). There is no loss of overs.
1523 local (0223 GMT) - The umpires think that the rain is too heavy now and have decided to call for the covers. Does not look too bad and it seems that they will be back shortly.
Length delivery on off, Conway pushes it towards point for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Conway pushes it through mid on for a couple.
Oshane Thomas is back into the attack. His figures so far are 2-0-17-1.
FOUR! 24 from the over! Floated delivery on middle, Phillips plays a reverse sweep over point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Tossed up just outside off, Phillips looks to go big but misses it.

SIX! That is hammered! Loopy delivery on off, Phillips lofts it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Three sixes in a row now for Phillips. Need to call the Fire department as he is on fire at the moment.
SIX! 50 for Glenn Phillips! It has been a fantastic innings from him! Short and outside off, Phillips smashes it over point for a maximum.
SIX! That is clobbered! Floated on middle, Phillips lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Fully utilizes the Free Hit, does Phillips.
NO BALL! BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Phillips looks to swing at it but misses it. Allen oversteps as the third umpire calls it a No Ball! A Free Hit will follow.
Flighted delivery on off, Conway looks to slash but gets an inside edge. It goes past the keeper towards fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Fabian Allen is back on. 2-0-11-1 so far.
On off, pushed to the covers.
On off, blocked.
SIX! An 81m six! Phillips is going after all the bowlers that he is facing! On a good length on off, Phillips lofts this one over the long on region for a biggie.
Short of a length ball on middle, Phillips tucks this towards mid on and they pick up a brace.
On middle, Glenn reverse sweeps this to short third man. They pick up a single and an overthrow by Cottrell means that they come back for the second run.
Misfield and a single! Back of a length ball on leg, Conway tickles this towards short fine leg where the fielder misfields and the batters take a single.
Rovman Powell is on.
FOUR! 18 runs off this over! Paul is getting a beating! A short ball on middle, Phillips hooks this one towards the deep square leg region to find the fence. Great batting. 100 up for the Kiwis.
FOUR! Over the off side now! What a shot! Outside off on a good length, Phillips smacks this over the point region for a boundary.
SIX! SHOT! Hit with some immense power! Back of a length ball on off, Phillips swivels and bangs this one over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
On a shorter length on middle, Conway pulls to the leg side to exchange ends with Glenn.
WIDE! A short ball outside the off stump. The umpire signals this as a wide.
On off, Phillips bunts this towards long on to cross ends.
A slower short ball on middle, Devon pulls this towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Keemo Paul is back on.
SIX! Great shot! Phillips is looking in good touch! On a good length on middle, Phillips heaves this one away to the fine leg fence for a biggie,
A slower off cutter around off, Glenn looks to cut but it comes off the under edge and bounces on the turf. A dot.
Good length ball on middle, Devon works this to mid-wicket for one. They think about the second but settle for one in the end.
On middle, flicked towards square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Deft placement! Wonderfully played! Back of a length ball on middle and off, Conway pulls this to the deep square leg fence to find the fence.
Back of a length ball on off, Glenn punches this towards deep covers for a single.
On middle, Phillips pushes it through mid on for a run.
Full delivery on off, Conway drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Conway plays a reverse sweep to short third man.
LEG BYE! Floated on leg, Phillips looks to sweep but gets it off the pads. It goes towards short fine leg. The batsmen cross ends. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Short delivery on off, Conway cuts it through point for a single.
Full on off, Conway drives it back towards the bowler.
Length delivery on off, Phillips keeps it out.
FOUR! That is put away! Short ball on middle, Phillips pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Conway punches it through covers for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Conway flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Length ball on middle, Phillips flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Conway punches it through mid on for a run.
On middle, Conway sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, Phillips punches it through point for a single.
Floated ball on off, Conway punches it towards point for a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, Phillips pushes it through mid off for a single.
Glenn Phillips is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! If the first review that West Indies took was poor, this was a great review! Another one falls! This has been a good little spell for West Indies. A flatter one around middle and leg, Guptill looks to tuck this away but misses and the keeper collects. There is a loud appeal but nothing from the umpire. Pollard takes the review. Ultra Edge rolls in and there is a clear spike and the umpire reverses his decision. Great work by Allen and Pooran.
The review is taken by West Indies! The man in question is Martin Guptill. The Men in Purple think that he has nicked this. Let's see what the replays have to say.
FOUR! Good shot! Short ball on middle, Guptill pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep tries to stop it but misfields and concedes a boundary.
Outside off, Conway punches this to point. The Kiwis are at 49/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Full delivery on off, Conway looks to dig this one out but misses.
Devon Conway is the new batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! DRAGGED ON! Thomas strikes and he gets the first wicket of the game! This shot was not needed at this stage! On a good length on off, Seifert shuffles across and looks to play the paddle scoop. He connects well too, but the ball goes onto clip the top of the off stump and the stumps light up. A good start by the Kiwis has been bought to a stop.
Back of a length on off, Martin taps this towards point for a single.
SIX! What a shot! Brilliant hitting by Guptill! Short of a length ball on off, Guptill makes some room and smacks this over the third man region for a six.
Short of a length on off, Tim pushes this to point for a quick single.
FOUR! Back of a length ball outside off, Guptill cuts this one over the point region for a boundary. An expensive start by Paul. 15 runs off his first over.
Outside off, Martin punches this to point.
SIX! Guptill is very strong down the ground! Clean strike! On a good length on off, Guptill lofts this one over the long on region for the first biggie of the game.
On middle, tucked towards mid on for a quick single.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! That is nicely played! Keemo is introduced into the attack with a boundary! On a good length on off, Seifert works this through backward point for a boundary.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.
Short of a length delivery on off, Guptill looks to play the upper cut but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Seifert pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball on off, Seifert pushes it to covers.
Good length delivery on off, Seifert keeps it out.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Full delivery on off, Seifert lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! Full ball on off, Seifert looks to drive it but it takes the outside edge and flies past short third man for a boundary.
Oshane Thomas is on.
Back of a length ball on middle, Seifert pulls this one to the leg side to keep the strike for the next over.
On middle, flicked towards deep square leg for one.
An appeal for lbw! Martin Guptill is the man in question. West review the decision.

NOT OUT! Guptill survives again! First the catch, now this LBW appeal! On a good length on middle and nipping away towards leg, Guptill looks to flick but misses. It hits his pads and goes towards the off side. The players appeal but not out says the umpire. Pollard makes the 'T' symbol and they take the review. Ball Tracker comes in and this one was pitching outside leg.
Short of a length on off, Martin pushes this to point.
Good length on off, Guptill looks to have a poke at this but misses it completely.
On middle, Tim tucks this to the leg side and calls for a quick single. Hetmyer has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
On off, pushed to cover-point for a dot to end the over. 10 runs off the second over.
WIDE! Short ball down the leg side. Wided.
FOUR! Dropped! On a good length on off, Guptill plays this one uppishly towards the cover region where Pollard looks to scalp this one but it goes through his hands to the ropes. A big chance missed.
FOUR! Second boundary of the contest! It is Guptill again who gets past the ropes! Back of a length on leg, Guptill clips this to deep square leg to find the ropes.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball on off, Guptill looks to play at this but misses.
On a good length on off, Guptill pushes this towards covers.
On off, Tim tucks this to square leg to open his account for this game.
Kyle Mayers to bowl from the other end.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Guptill and the Kiwis are underway with a boundary! A great stroke! A good length ball on off, Guptill slashes this over backward point and it races away to the ropes.
Short of a length ball on off, Martin pushes this to covers.
A yorker on off, Guptill looks to dig this one out but he does not connect bat with ball.
Back of a length on off, Martin blocks this one out.
Cottrell starts off with a good length outside off, Guptill raises his bat and leaves it alone.

Right then! We are done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to begin. The players of West Indies make their way out to middle and look to go to their respective positions out on the field. The openers of New Zealand, Martin Guptill and Tim Seifert stride out into the middle.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, Ross Taylor, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee (C), Ish Sodhi, Kyle Jamieson, Lockie Ferguson.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Andre Fletcher, Brandon King, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Rovman Powell, Kieron Pollard (C), Fabian Allen, Keemo Paul, Kyle Mayers, Oshane Thomas, Sheldon Cottrell.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop is out there for the pitch report. Says that it is 22 degrees and it is overcast. He says that it looks nice and lovely and the surface is well grassed and the surface feels relatively hard as well. Feels that the ball might come on to the bat nicely.

New Zealand skipper, Tim Southee says that it is a good wicket and they would have bowled first well and they want to put a score and defend it. Adds that batting first has been good here but with rain at the horizon, they would have batted second. States that there is a single change as Ish Sodhi comes in place of Hamish Bennett.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says that the conditions have decided him to bowl first. Adds that they will look to make some smarter decisions out on the field. States that there is a single change as Kyle Mayers make his debut in place of Kesrick Williams. Feels that they make this change to see how things will work out.

TOSS - It's time to give a flip to the coin. The two skippers, Kieron Pollard and Tim Southee are out in the middle along with the match referee. Up she goes and it lands in favour of Kieron Pollard. WEST INDIES HAVE DECIDED TO BOWL FIRST!

1343 local (0043 GMT) - The covers have been peeled off and so the toss will happen shortly. It's slightly overcast but let's hope that we see a full game of cricket. The toss will be at 1355 local (0055 GMT). The start time for the game has been decided at 1415 local (0115 GMT).
1330 local (0030 GMT) - There is a slight drizzle and the covers are in place right now and so the toss has been delayed slightly.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I in the three match series between New Zealand and West Indies. The first game was not spared by the rain gods and they poured down to show their presence but that did not stop us from having a game of cricket. The Kiwis held their nerve in that crunch series opener and are leading the 3-match series 1-0. They will be looking to win this encounter and wrap up the T20I series. The Men in Purple, on the other hand, will want to put in a strong display and will want to take this series to the last game. An exciting game of cricket awaits. Join us as we bring you the toss and the team updates...
